entities.name: Murmuring Bosk
entities.description: A sacred grove of Lorwyn treefolk in the Great Forest, now in ruin but beginning to regrow.

entities.name: Great Forest
entities.description: Forest of Lorwyn containing the Bosk.

entities.name: Treefolk
entities.description: Parliamentary tree-people who began as ordinary trees in the Bosk.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: Elf who arrived at the Bosk in 4520 AR to plant Colfenor's cone.

entities.name: Colfenor
entities.description: Treefolk who asked Rhys to plant his cone at the Bosk.

entities.name: Rising
entities.description: Event after which treefolk gained the ability to walk freely.

events.summary: The Bosk is found leveled, uprooted, hacked and burned by unknown hands.
events.quote: The trees were torn out of the ground, hacked, and burned, all by unknown hands that acted with sustained will.

events.summary: Rhys arrives in 4520 AR at Colfenor's request and plants Colfenor's cone; later he finds the Bosk regrowing.

relations.note: Sacred grove in the Great Forest.
relations.quote: The Murmuring Bosk was a sacred grove of Lorwyn treefolk in the Great Forest .

relations.note: Went to plant his cone at his request.
relations.quote: after Colfenor asked him to plant his cone there
